fieldValues.title: srs-programme: the first document renders nothing
fieldValues.summary: The editor opens the first composition, semanticops-roadmap, which is unbound: rendered on its own it gives 29 characters and 'needs a supplied container'.
evidence: 23 compositions, many from shared packages (agent routines, argument readers); none is a front door
fieldValues.body:
Remedies: a bound front-door composition installed first (needs a way to order compositions; there is no command), or the editor supplying the root container to an unbound first composition (srs#851's direction), or the spec's root view binding (RFC-013 OQ-1). The exercise on the front door holds the options.

Filed as srs-rust#1532 (a command to move a composition first), under epic semanticops.com#52.
